short_reading.title: Our Town
short_reading.text: My town has a big park and a library. There is a fountain near the town hall. On Saturday, many visitors come to the market. The mayor says hello to them.

questions.q: Who says hello to the visitors?

short_reading.title: A Good Neighbour
short_reading.text: Lan is our neighbour. She is kind and helpful. When my mum is ill, she brings us soup. We respect her very much.
